gameDescriptionHtml:
“STARNAUT” is an easy-to-learn, hard-to-master “survivor-like” game that emphasizes massive Nitro Jumps and Dashes, evading with verticality, synergizing extremely powerful weapons, deep and considered lore, and of course, the strongest force in the universe….love!

Choose your 8 favourite weapons, and annihilate endless hordes of enemies! Feel the excitement of mowing down entire armies of the creeping terror known only as ZOL!

BE CAREFUL!! This game is way too addictive! Time flies when you’re having fun!

Mission 1: Explore the Multiverse – Starnaut’s unique power draws together distant realities through the multiverse, forming the stages where your battles unfold! Over 60 diverse and exciting stages!. Clear them all!
Mission 2: Survive the Invasion – Take down swarms of invaders pouring from the multiverse! Some look cute, but don’t be fooled! Not an expert at shooters? No problem! Your weapons attack automatically!
Mission 3: Power Up with Coins – Defeated enemies drop coins! Spend them at the Shopnaut for crucial weapon upgrades and power-ups during your run.
Mission 4: Launch Rockets and Get Oxygen – Launch 10 Ω Rockets to clear each stage! They’re also your lifeline, providing vital oxygen – activate them regularly to stay alive!
Mission 5: Collect Earth’s data! – Hunt down elusive carriers holding fragments of Earth’s “Lost Data.” Punch them to retrieve these vital records!
Mission…. WHATEVER!! JUST BEAT EM AS MANY AS YOU CAN!!!! – Those enemies are not only hungry for you but YOUR KNUCKLE SANDWICH!!! There are things like a gacha capsule, jump pad or even a hot spring! Also, you can buy a new helmet and upgrade your spacesuit to enhance your basic abilities before you start the level. Everything for you! Just use them well!!

STARNAUT, FIGHT SOLO! ANNIHILATE EM!
